title: Consulting Engineer | 5+ Years, SP(NMS & Orchestration/virtualization technologies))
teaser: We are looking for a Consulting Engineer to design and deploy robust Service Provider solutions, acting as a trusted technical advisor for major enterprises. You will lead complex engagements, shape architectural direction, and integrate AI and automation. Ideal candidates have significant experience in network management and advanced SQL skills.
description:
Meet the Team

The Customer Experience (CX) team is a group of extraordinary technical experts whose focus is delivering a world-class customer experience by solving the toughest business challenges with network-centric solutions. We accelerate customer and partner success through groundbreaking technology design, implementation, and optimization across a broad range of Cisco technologies. Our team collaborates closely with Cisco account teams, partners, and multi-functional groups to drive meaningful technology transitions and deliver real business outcomes. We are a high-performing, globally connected team with a strong culture of continuous learning, mentorship, and knowledge sharing. Our impact is validated through strong financial results, industry recognition, and some of the highest customer and employee satisfaction scores at Cisco.

Your Impact 

As a Consulting Engineer, you will support the design and deployment of robust Service Provider solutions that drive key business outcomes, acting as a trusted technical advisor to customers. This role is exciting because you'll own complex engagements end-to-end, shape architectural direction for major enterprises, and drive innovation by integrating AI and automation into how Cisco delivers services — all while expanding your influence across teams.

Lead the execution of design, deployment, migration, and optimization of robust service provider for strategic customers.

Create customer-facing documentation, migration plans, and implementation plans aligned to CX standards; build complex test environments to validate designs.

Engage in customer solution discussions — connecting proposed solutions to business priorities

Minimum Qualifications:   

Requires BS/BE/BTech degree or equivalent with 5+ years of experience in a similar job role.

Any Service Provider related certification (CCNA, CCNP - DevOps) is helpful and you have a drive for continuous learning.

Expertise in handling Network Management (NMS) tools/applications

Advanced understanding/Experience with SQL databases and Postgres SQL

Knowledge of software programmability, automation (Python, YAML, JSON, GitHub, Ansible, Terraform and so on), orchestration, and/or virtualization technologies.

Advance level of Linux/Unix OS administration & troubleshooting

Understanding of Virtualisation technologies (VMware, Docker, Kubernetes);

Network Automation & Controllers: Crosswork, Cisco NSO and PCA

Knowledge and hands-on of Agentic AI Tools development and Industry Models

Knowledge on NCS540, NCS560, ASR9k NCS55xx and Cisco 8k platforms.

Preferred Qualifications:

Understanding of relevant Cisco technologies and delivery methods and builds skills in articulating technical concepts.

Foundational consulting and collaboration skills 

Leverages AI and automation to enhance delivery efficiency, innovation and customer outcomes, while also increasing personal productivity and focus on high-impact work

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
